items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.

items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，而非一项新试验。作者指出，ALS早期和中期试验常被用来宣称临床获益，但这些结果屡屡无法在3期试验中重现，形成了“临床试验可信度差距”。文章将原因归咎于产业界与学术界错位激励下的“临床试验工业复合体”，并列举了若干反复出现的谬误：结局比较前提错误、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签数据、对无定论结果过度乐观。作者呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的分流。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇文章的价值不在于提供新机制或新疗法，而在于对当前试验生态的系统性批评。它提醒研究者在设计、解读和传播早期试验结果时警惕几类常见谬误，尤其是生物标志物（如NfL）的误用、事后分析和开放标签扩展数据的过度解读。文章提出的“更严格分流2期项目”和“区分假设生成与假设检验”对试验设计、终点选择和申办方决策具有直接参考意义，也有助于理解为何部分ALS试验在早期信号与3期失败之间反复出现落差。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来宣称临床获益，但这些获益未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个极大影响试验设计、数据解读和结果传播的“临床试验工业复合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标不匹配、选择性报告结局、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既有的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，直面ALS临床试验中长期存在的早期信号与3期失败之间的可信度差距，对试验设计、生物标志物解读和结果报告提出方法学改革呼吁，具有直接的转化与监管参考价值。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.

items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒在神经退行性疾病治疗中的应用：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药来源的生物活性分子（如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素、EGCG）通过纳米递送系统治疗阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和ALS等神经退行性疾病的研究进展。文章重点讨论了如何利用纳米载体改善这些天然分子的稳定性、血脑屏障穿透能力和脑内蓄积，并覆盖了疾病特异性靶点、纳米毒理学、生产可扩展性、质量控制与监管等转化瓶颈。作者明确指出：目前临床前结果虽令人鼓舞，但临床证据有限，尚无任何草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证实明确疗效或获批上市。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值不在于提供新的ALS特异性疗效数据，而在于它把“草药活性分子+纳米递送”这一常被边缘化的方向，放进了与蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍等ALS核心病理机制对话的框架中。它提醒我们：血脑屏障穿透和脑内有效浓度仍是ALS药物开发的共同瓶颈，而纳米载体设计、仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡等策略可能为现有候选分子提供重新评估的机会。同时，文章对纳米毒理学、批次一致性和监管路径的强调，有助于避免把临床前信号过早误读为临床突破。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征是进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管传统疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与以往综述不同，它整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的以往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面而批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8 获取。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了仿生纳米颗粒与细胞外囊泡等递送技术，并明确将ALS纳入神经退行性疾病框架，但其转化价值目前仍停留在临床前与监管讨论层面，尚未产生ALS临床疗效证据。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.evidenceLevel: 专家评论/综述（基于家族病例报道的机制讨论）
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 该文指出，ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增不仅是脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型的致病原因，也是 ALS 的重要风险因素。新报道的阿卡迪亚家族呈现隐性遗传模式，提示 ATXN2 相关疾病并非仅由显性功能获得机制驱动。重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量可能改变遗传模式，部分情境下功能丧失机制也可能参与发病。文章强调，未来需对 ATXN2 相关疾病进行遗传分层，以指导分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略。
items.insight: ATXN2 是 ALS 领域少数具有明确遗传证据且可干预的靶点之一。该文提示，ATXN2 相关疾病的遗传模式和致病机制可能比既往认为的更复杂，单纯以显性功能获得模型解释所有病例可能不足。对 ALS 研究者而言，这直接影响患者遗传咨询、临床试验入组标准以及反义寡核苷酸等靶向 ATXN2 疗法的患者选择策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅由常染色体显性功能获得机制驱动；隐性遗传、重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量均可影响遗传模式和致病机制。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为评论性文章，主要基于单个阿卡迪亚家族的隐性遗传报道进行机制推演，未提供大规模人群或功能实验验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注 ATXN2 重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量对 ALS 风险及表型的影响，以及这些因素如何用于遗传分层和靶向治疗患者选择。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性变的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来认为其主要由常染色体显性、功能获得驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能随重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下参与发病。我们讨论了这对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的意义，强调需要进行遗传分层。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于 2026 年发表，聚焦 ATXN2 这一 ALS 重要风险基因，提出隐性遗传和功能丧失机制可能参与发病，对遗传分层和靶向治疗策略具有直接转化意义。

items.title: Natural monomer compounds in neurodegenerative diseases: Targeting ferroptosis and neuroinflammation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss driven by oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and chronic neuroinflammation. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent and lipid peroxidation-associated form of regulated cell death, has recently been identified as a key contributor to neuronal vulnerability. Emerging evidence demonstrates that purified natural monomer compounds derived from medicinal plants exert potent neuroprotective effects by targeting ferroptosis and neuroinflammatory pathways. Representative agents such as curcumin, baicalin, resveratrol, and ginsenoside Rg1 activate nuclear factor E2-related factor-2 and glutathione peroxidase 4 signaling to preserve redox balance, while suppressing microglia-mediated inflammation through inhibition of toll-like receptor 4 pathways. This review highlights the interplay between ferroptosis and neuroinflammation in NDDs, summarizes the regulatory effects of bioactive herbal monomer compounds, and discusses recent advances in multi-omics profiling, nano-delivery strategies, and translational research. By modulating the ferroptosis-neuroinflammation axis, these compounds may represent promising therapeutic candidates for NDDs.
items.titleZh: 天然单体化合物在神经退行性疾病中的作用：靶向铁死亡与神经炎症
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦于天然单体化合物（如姜黄素、黄芩苷、白藜芦醇、人参皂苷Rg1）在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病中的神经保护潜力。文章指出，这些化合物通过激活Nrf2/GPX4信号通路维持氧化还原平衡，并抑制TLR4介导的小胶质细胞炎症，从而同时靶向铁死亡和神经炎症这两个关键病理过程。综述还讨论了多组学、纳米递送等转化研究进展，认为调节铁死亡-神经炎症轴是潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述将铁死亡与神经炎症的交互作用置于ALS等神经退行性疾病的核心，并系统梳理了天然单体化合物通过Nrf2/GPX4和TLR4通路同时干预这两个过程的证据。对于ALS研究者，这提示了多靶点天然产物作为候选治疗策略的潜力，尤其是纳米递送和多组学整合可能加速转化。但需注意，目前证据主要来自临床前研究，尚需临床试验验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 天然单体化合物（如姜黄素、黄芩苷、白藜芦醇、人参皂苷Rg1）通过激活Nrf2/GPX4和抑制TLR4通路，同时靶向铁死亡和神经炎症，在神经退行性疾病中发挥神经保护作用。
aiRead.limitation: 证据主要来自临床前研究，缺乏临床试验验证；天然化合物的生物利用度和血脑屏障穿透性仍是转化障碍。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注这些天然单体化合物在ALS临床试验中的进展，以及纳米递送和多组学策略如何推动其转化应用。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征是由氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和慢性神经炎症驱动的进行性神经元丢失。铁死亡是一种铁依赖性和脂质过氧化相关的调节性细胞死亡形式，最近被确定为神经元易损性的关键因素。新出现的证据表明，源自药用植物的纯化天然单体化合物通过靶向铁死亡和神经炎症通路发挥有效的神经保护作用。代表性药物如姜黄素、黄芩苷、白藜芦醇和人参皂苷Rg1激活核因子E2相关因子2和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4信号以维持氧化还原平衡，同时通过抑制Toll样受体4通路抑制小胶质细胞介导的炎症。本综述强调了铁死亡与神经炎症在NDDs中的相互作用，总结了生物活性草药单体化合物的调节作用，并讨论了多组学分析、纳米递送策略和转化研究的最新进展。通过调节铁死亡-神经炎症轴，这些化合物可能代表NDDs的有前景的治疗候选物。

items.title: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Diseases Increase ALS Risk by 82% While Optimal Cardiovascular Health Halves It: A 0.5-Million Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: The objective of this study was to determine whether prevalent atherosclerotic cardiovascular diseases (ASCVDs) increase the risk of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and whether high cardiovascular health (CVH) can offset this risk. We prospectively analyzed 502,279 UK Biobank participants (37-73 years) with linked electronic health records. Prevalent ASCVD (coronary artery disease [CAD], ischemic stroke [IS], and peripheral artery disease [PAD]) was ascertained at baseline. CVH was quantified using Life's Essential 8 and categorized as low, moderate, or high. Cox models, joint analyses, and Mendelian randomization were applied. Over a median follow-up of 13.74 years, 675 incident ALS cases were documented. A history of ASCVD was associated with a 43% higher risk of ALS (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.16-1.78, p = 0.001), primarily driven by CAD and IS. Conversely, high CVH was associated with a lower risk of ALS compared with low CVH (HR = 0.52, 95% CI = 0.33-0.81, p = 0.004). Joint analysis revealed that individuals with low CVH and pre-existing ASCVD exhibited the highest ALS risk. Mendelian randomization analyses provided supportive evidence consistent with the observational associations among CAD, IS, and ALS. The inverse association between CVH and ALS risk was most pronounced among participants aged ≤65 years. Prevalent ASCVD was associated with a higher risk of ALS, whereas high CVH was associated with a lower risk of ALS. These findings support a potential link between CVH and ALS susceptibility, particularly among individuals aged ≤65 years. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.titleZh: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病使ALS风险增加82%，而理想心血管健康可使其减半：一项50万人前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于英国生物银行50余万人的前瞻性队列研究发现，基线患有动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（尤其是冠心病和缺血性卒中）与ALS风险升高43%相关；而心血管健康评分高者ALS风险降低约一半。两者联合时，低心血管健康且已有心血管疾病者风险最高。孟德尔随机化分析支持冠心病、缺血性卒中与ALS之间的关联。该关联在65岁及以下人群中更明显。
items.insight: 该研究将心血管健康这一可干预因素与ALS易感性联系起来，提示血管危险因素和血管健康状态可能参与ALS发病过程。对于ALS研究者而言，值得跟踪的是：心血管疾病与ALS的关联是否反映共同的上游机制（如慢性炎症、代谢紊乱或血管功能障碍），以及改善心血管健康能否在更年轻人群中降低ALS风险。孟德尔随机化提供的支持性证据增强了因果推断的可能性，但仍需机制研究和干预试验验证。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在确定基线存在的动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）是否增加肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险，以及高心血管健康（CVH）能否抵消这一风险。我们前瞻性分析了502,279名英国生物银行参与者（37-73岁）及其关联的电子健康记录。基线时确定现患ASCVD（冠状动脉疾病[CAD]、缺血性卒中[IS]和外周动脉疾病[PAD]）。CVH采用Life's Essential 8进行量化，分为低、中、高三个等级。应用了Cox模型、联合分析和孟德尔随机化。在中位随访13.74年期间，记录了675例新发ALS病例。有ASCVD病史与ALS风险增加43%相关（风险比[HR]=1.43，95%置信区间[CI]=1.16-1.78，p=0.001），主要由CAD和IS驱动。相反，与低CVH相比，高CVH与较低的ALS风险相关（HR=0.52，95%CI=0.33-0.81，p=0.004）。联合分析显示，低CVH且已有ASCVD的个体ALS风险最高。孟德尔随机化分析提供了与CAD、IS和ALS之间观察性关联一致的支持性证据。CVH与ALS风险之间的负相关在年龄≤65岁的参与者中最为显著。现患ASCVD与较高的ALS风险相关，而高CVH与较低的ALS风险相关。这些发现支持CVH与ALS易感性之间的潜在联系，尤其是在年龄≤65岁的个体中。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 这项2026年发表的大规模前瞻性队列研究结合孟德尔随机化，新近揭示了心血管健康与ALS风险之间的剂量-反应关系，为ALS的可干预危险因素和转化预防策略提供了重要线索。

items.title: Innovative therapies under clinical development for ALS treatment. Part 2: biologics and natural products.
items.summary: The clinical trial landscape for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is rapidly expanding despite ongoing translational challenges. Following our 2022 analysis and as a continuation of Part 1, which focused on small molecules, this review provides a structured overview of biologics and natural products in the ALS clinical pipeline. Particular emphasis is placed on candidates that entered, advanced through, or completed clinical evaluation between 2022 and the end of 2025. Clinical trials for ALS registered in the United States (ClinicalTrials.gov) and the European Union (EU Clinical Trials Register/CTIS) were systematically reviewed and are summarized in this report. Modern biotechnology, ethnopharmacology, and classical pharmacology are increasingly converging in ALS therapeutic development, making this one of the most active areas of neurodegenerative disease research. Nevertheless, major challenges remain, including central nervous system (CNS) penetration, long-term safety, interpatient variability, limited clinical evidence, and the need for reliable biomarkers. Emerging technologies, such as big data analytics and artificial intelligence, may help accelerate and optimize therapeutic development, as well as improve patient recruitment and stratification.

items.titleZh: ALS治疗中处于临床开发阶段的创新疗法。第2部分：生物制品与天然产物
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了2022年至2025年底期间在美国和欧盟注册的、针对ALS的生物制品和天然产物类候选疗法的临床试验情况。文章指出，生物技术、民族药理学和经典药理学正在融合，推动ALS治疗开发成为神经退行性疾病研究中最活跃的领域之一。但该领域仍面临CNS穿透性差、长期安全性不明、患者间差异大、临床证据有限和缺乏可靠生物标志物等挑战。大数据和人工智能有望加速开发并改善患者招募与分层。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了一份截至2025年底的生物制品和天然产物类临床试验全景图，有助于快速了解除小分子之外的治疗管线布局、候选药物的临床进展阶段以及该领域反复出现的转化瓶颈（如CNS穿透和生物标志物缺乏）。对于关注非小分子类ALS疗法、寻找潜在合作或投资方向、以及设计未来临床试验的研究者而言，这是一份具有时效性的参考。

items.abstractZh: 尽管转化研究仍面临持续挑战，肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的临床试验格局正在迅速扩大。继我们2022年的分析之后，并作为聚焦小分子的第1部分的延续，本综述对ALS临床研发管线中的生物制品和天然产物进行了结构化概述。重点关注在2022年至2025年底期间进入临床评价、在临床评价中取得进展或完成临床评价的候选药物。本报告系统综述了在美国（ClinicalTrials.gov）和欧盟（EU Clinical Trials Register/CTIS）注册的ALS临床试验，并对其进行了总结。现代生物技术、民族药理学和经典药理学在ALS治疗开发中日益融合，使其成为神经退行性疾病研究中最为活跃的领域之一。然而，重大挑战依然存在，包括中枢神经系统（CNS）穿透性、长期安全性、患者间变异性、有限的临床证据以及对可靠生物标志物的需求。大数据分析和人工智能等新兴技术可能有助于加速和优化治疗开发，并改善患者招募和分层。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述覆盖2022年至2025年底最新注册的ALS生物制品与天然产物临床试验，系统呈现了当前转化开发中最活跃且挑战集中的前沿方向。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究采用网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞体外实验，探讨持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜在关联。分析识别出90个共有靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激及IL-17/TNF等炎症通路；分子对接提示FKBP12-mTOR复合物为候选结合系统，MD模拟支持该构象稳定。细胞实验中，BDE-209在10 μM升高p-mTOR、20 μM升高IL-1β，雷帕霉素可减弱p-mTOR反应，但IL-1β诱导是否依赖mTOR未确定；40 μM时细胞活力下降，可能存在沉淀或聚集混杂。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性尚未验证。
items.insight: 该研究将环境毒理学与ALS等神经退行性疾病机制联系起来，提出BDE-209可能通过mTOR信号失调发挥细胞效应，为ALS环境风险因素研究提供了可检验的候选通路。但当前证据仅来自网络预测和PC12细胞模型，mTOR直接结合、慢性暴露效应及体内疾病相关性均未证实，ALS研究者可关注后续是否在ALS模型或患者样本中验证mTOR通路及环境暴露标志物。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共有靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。分子对接将FKBP12-mTOR复合物优先列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示持久性环境污染物BDE-209可能通过mTOR失调与ALS等神经退行性疾病相关，具有环境暴露与ALS机制研究的转化探索价值。

items.title: Selective Neuroprotection in the ALS-FTD Spectrum: Mechanisms of Neuronal Resilience and Translational Perspectives.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is increasingly recognized as part of a broader clinico-pathological continuum encompassing frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Despite progressive degeneration across motor and cognitive neural systems associated with TDP-43 pathology, specific neuronal populations-including the oculomotor and abducens nuclei, Onuf's nucleus, and sensory dorsal column pathways-remain relatively preserved. Selectively preserved neuronal structures in ALS have largely been described as isolated neuropathological observations without sufficient mechanistic integration. This review aims to synthesize candidate intrinsic and microenvironmental mechanisms that may contribute to selective neuronal preservation and propose a translational framework for understanding neuronal resilience in the ALS-FTD spectrum. We conducted a comprehensive critical review of the literature addressing selective neuronal vulnerability and resistance in ALS-FTD, integrating comparative observations from related neurodegenerative and neuromuscular disorders. Particular emphasis was placed on candidate mechanisms associated with neuronal resilience, including Nrf2/ARE signaling, calcium homeostasis, glutamatergic receptor composition, glial-mediated neurotrophic support, and emerging transcriptomic evidence relevant to selective neuronal vulnerability. Selective preservation of specific neuronal populations represents a distinctive biological characteristic of the ALS-FTD spectrum. Current evidence suggests that enhanced antioxidant defense, tightly regulated intracellular calcium dynamics, protective microenvironmental interactions, and other stress-response pathways may collectively contribute to resistance against TDP-43 proteinopathy. These findings may provide a mechanistic framework for understanding selective neuronal resilience and suggest potential avenues for future neuroprotective therapeutic development. Integrating mechanisms of selective neuroprotection with translational neurobiological perspectives may provide a conceptual framework for ALS research. Leveraging preserved neural systems may not only inform biologically grounded supportive care strategies but also help identify mechanistically relevant targets for future disease-modifying interventions.
items.titleZh: ALS-FTD谱系中的选择性神经保护：神经元韧性机制与转化前景
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS-FTD谱系中为何某些神经元（如动眼神经核、Onuf核、感觉背柱通路）能在TDP-43病理背景下相对保留。作者整合了Nrf2/ARE抗氧化通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸受体组成、胶质细胞营养支持及转录组学等候选机制，提出选择性神经元韧性可能是多因素共同作用的结果，并主张将这一机制框架用于未来神经保护治疗靶点的发现和支持性照护策略的优化。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS中长期以来被当作孤立病理现象的选择性神经元保留，提升为一个可机制化研究的韧性表型。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：第一，它把动眼神经核、Onuf核等保留结构从描述性病理学转化为可比较、可实验的模型系统；第二，它整合了Nrf2/ARE、钙稳态、谷氨酸受体组成和胶质支持等可干预通路，为神经保护靶点筛选提供了候选清单；第三，它提示利用内源性保护机制可能比单纯对抗TDP-43毒性更具转化可行性。

aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，本文未提供原始实验数据，所提出的机制框架主要基于现有文献的整合与推断，各候选机制之间的因果关系和相对贡献尚未在统一模型中验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）日益被认为是一个更广泛的临床-病理连续谱的一部分，该连续谱涵盖额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。尽管与TDP-43病理相关的运动与认知神经系统出现进行性变性，特定神经元群体——包括动眼神经核和展神经核、Onuf核以及感觉背柱通路——仍相对保留。ALS中选择性保留的神经元结构在很大程度上被描述为孤立的神经病理学观察，缺乏充分的机制整合。本综述旨在综合可能促成选择性神经元保留的候选内在与微环境机制，并提出一个用于理解ALS-FTD谱系中神经元韧性的转化框架。我们对涉及ALS-FTD中选择性神经元易感性与抵抗性的文献进行了全面的批判性综述，整合了来自相关神经退行性疾病和神经肌肉疾病中的比较观察。特别关注与神经元韧性相关的候选机制，包括Nrf2/ARE信号通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸能受体组成、胶质细胞介导的神经营养支持，以及与选择性神经元易感性相关的新兴转录组学证据。特定神经元群体的选择性保留是ALS-FTD谱系的一个独特生物学特征。当前证据提示，增强的抗氧化防御、严格调控的细胞内钙动态、保护性微环境相互作用以及其他应激反应通路可能共同促成对TDP-43蛋白病的抵抗。这些发现可能为理解选择性神经元韧性提供机制框架，并提示未来神经保护治疗开发的潜在途径。将选择性神经保护机制与转化神经生物学视角相整合，可能为ALS研究提供一个概念框架。利用保留的神经系统不仅可能为有生物学依据的支持性照护策略提供信息，还可能有助于识别未来疾病修饰干预的机制相关靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，聚焦ALS-FTD谱系中选择性神经元韧性的多机制整合，为神经保护治疗靶点发现提供了新的概念框架和转化视角。

items.title: Motor coordination and behavioural deficits in a mouse model of KMT2B-related dystonia.
items.summary: Pathogenic variants in KMT2B cause early-onset dystonia, but a mouse model that has undergone comprehensive, dystonia-oriented phenotyping is lacking. We conducted detailed phenotyping on heterozygous Kmt2b constitutive knockout mice and wild-type littermates, assessing growth, neurobehavioural traits, motor coordination, sensorimotor gating, social behaviour and metabolic parameters, combined with striatal RNA sequencing. Kmt2b knockout mice of both sexes were viable but significantly smaller and lighter than littermate controls. Knockouts were hyperlocomotive in the open field and showed approximately two-fold larger acoustic startle responses; unexpectedly, prepulse inhibition was enhanced rather than reduced at all prepulse intensities. On the balance beam, knockouts crossed more slowly and paused more frequently; female knockouts also paused more on the ladder rung task. Frame-by-frame video analysis revealed a claw-like hindpaw posture characterized by abnormal inward flexion of the digits. Knockout mice spent less time investigating a novel conspecific, while social recognition memory remained intact. Striatal RNA sequencing confirmed reduction of Kmt2b transcript to approximately half of control levels and identified 177 differentially expressed genes, including Maob, encoding monoamine oxidase B; gene set enrichment analysis implicated neurodevelopmental, glial and mitochondrial processes. Nociception, vision, body-weight-adjusted grip strength, and clinical chemistry and haematological measures were largely unaffected. Heterozygous Kmt2b knockout mice show hyperlocomotion, altered sensorimotor gating, impaired motor coordination with dystonic-like paw posturing and reduced sociability, alongside a striatal transcriptomic signature implicating neurodevelopmental processes. The model mirrors aspects of human KMT2B-related dystonia and provides a platform for mechanistic study; environmental or pharmacological challenge may be needed to unmask overt dystonic features.
items.titleZh: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型中的运动协调与行为缺陷
items.summaryZh: 该研究对杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行了系统的行为与纹状体转录组分析，发现其存在活动过度、惊跳反应增强、前脉冲抑制反常增强、运动协调下降、肌张力障碍样后爪姿势及社交性降低，纹状体转录组提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程改变。该模型部分再现人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，但未出现明显自发肌张力障碍，提示需额外挑战才能显现。
items.insight: KMT2B是早发性肌张力障碍的重要基因，其与ALS等神经退行性疾病的关联主要在于共同的神经发育、纹状体环路和线粒体/转录调控机制。该研究提供了首个较全面的Kmt2b杂合敲除小鼠行为与纹状体转录组图谱，有助于理解KMT2B单倍剂量不足如何影响运动协调、感觉运动门控和社交行为，并为后续机制研究及药物/环境挑战实验提供模型基础。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示发育期转录调控异常可能通过纹状体和线粒体通路影响运动表型，值得与ALS中的RNA代谢和线粒体功能障碍研究交叉参考。

items.abstractZh: KMT2B的致病性变异可导致早发性肌张力障碍，但目前尚缺乏经过全面、以肌张力障碍为导向的表型分析的小鼠模型。我们对杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠及其野生型同窝对照进行了详细表型分析，评估了生长、神经行为特征、运动协调、感觉运动门控、社会行为和代谢参数，并结合纹状体RNA测序。两种性别的Kmt2b敲除小鼠均可存活，但显著小于并轻于同窝对照。敲除小鼠在旷场中活动过度，听觉惊跳反应约增大两倍；出乎意料的是，在所有前脉冲强度下，前脉冲抑制均增强而非减弱。在平衡木上，敲除小鼠通过速度更慢、停顿更频繁；雌性敲除小鼠在梯级任务中停顿也更多。逐帧视频分析揭示了一种爪样后爪姿势，其特征为趾部异常向内屈曲。敲除小鼠用于探究新异同种个体的时间减少，而社会识别记忆保持完整。纹状体RNA测序证实Kmt2b转录本降至对照水平约一半，并鉴定出177个差异表达基因，包括编码单胺氧化酶B的Maob；基因集富集分析提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程受累。痛觉、视觉、体重校正后的握力以及临床化学和血液学指标基本未受影响。杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损伴肌张力障碍样爪姿势以及社交性降低，同时具有提示神经发育过程的纹状体转录组特征。该模型反映了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍的某些方面，为机制研究提供了平台；可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示明显的肌张力障碍特征。

items.title: Retromer-targeted therapy for neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) are neurodegenerative diseases characterized by dysfunction of the endosomal-lysosomal system (ELS). Four shared neurodegenerative mechanisms across ALS, PD and AD are regulated by the ELS, namely proteostasis and related protein misfolding, mitochondrial function, neurotransmission and neuroinflammation. These mechanisms are interconnected, contributing to neurodegeneration in a "snowball" manner. The retromer, a multimeric, evolutionarily conserved protein complex involved in intracellular protein trafficking, is at the crossroad of these neurodegenerative processes. This narrative review focuses on exploring the retromer structure, function as a master regulator of the ELS, and how this impacts proteostasis, mitochondrial biogenesis and homeostasis, neurotransmission and neuroinflammation across neurodegenerative diseases. We explore how alterations in retromer function can play an important role in neurodegeneration and discuss the impact of genetic and pharmacological manipulations of VPS35, one of the main retromer subunits. In vitro and in vivo studies have identified that the retromer enhances the activity of protein degradation pathways via the ELS, namely macroautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, and the ELS itself, with concomitant reduction in misfolded protein levels. Also, in some model systems, when the retromer role is enhanced or restored, mitochondrial function is rescued, dysfunctional neurotransmission is restored, and the damaging effects of neuroinflammation are dampened. Lastly, we highlight the role of a novel pharmacological class of agents that enhance retromer function as a strategy for potentially slowing the progression of these neurodegenerative diseases in in vivo models of PD and ALS. We discuss the challenges in targeting the retromer, current limitations and potential off-target effects of retromer enhancement. Overall, the retromer regulates shared mechanisms across neurodegenerative diseases and retromer enhancers could represent a novel disease-modifying strategy in AD, PD and ALS.

items.abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是以内体-溶酶体系统（ELS）功能障碍为特征的神经退行性疾病。ALS、PD和AD中共有的四种神经退行性机制受ELS调控，即蛋白质稳态及相关蛋白错误折叠、线粒体功能、神经传递和神经炎症。这些机制相互关联，以“滚雪球”方式促进神经退行性变。逆转录体是一种多聚体、进化上保守的蛋白质复合物，参与细胞内蛋白质运输，处于这些神经退行性过程的交叉点。本叙述性综述聚焦于探索逆转录体的结构、作为ELS主调控因子的功能，以及这如何影响神经退行性疾病中的蛋白质稳态、线粒体生物发生和稳态、神经传递和神经炎症。我们探讨逆转录体功能的改变如何在神经退行性变中发挥重要作用，并讨论VPS35（逆转录体主要亚基之一）遗传和药理学操作的影响。体外和体内研究已发现，逆转录体通过ELS增强蛋白质降解途径的活性，即巨自噬、分子伴侣介导的自噬和ELS本身，同时减少错误折叠蛋白水平。此外，在某些模型系统中，当逆转录体作用被增强或恢复时，线粒体功能得到挽救，功能障碍的神经传递得到恢复，神经炎症的破坏性效应被减弱。最后，我们强调了一类新型药理学药物增强逆转录体功能的作用，作为在PD和ALS体内模型中潜在减缓这些神经退行性疾病进展的策略。我们讨论了靶向逆转录体的挑战、当前局限性和逆转录体增强的潜在脱靶效应。总体而言，逆转录体调控神经退行性疾病中的共有机制，逆转录体增强剂可能代表AD、PD和ALS中一种新型疾病修饰策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了逆转录体作为ALS等神经退行性疾病共有机制调控节点的新近证据，并指出逆转录体增强剂在ALS动物模型中具有潜在疾病修饰转化价值。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ~90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症血液生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究从全血和血浆中免疫分离星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs），检测其中TDP-43及其磷酸化形式pTDP-43的水平，发现血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值能较好区分ALS患者与健康对照，逻辑回归模型平均AUC达0.89，敏感性和特异性分别约87%和89%。研究提示该指标有望作为ALS血液生物标志物，并可能用于TDP-43靶向临床试验的患者分层，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联尚待验证。
items.insight: 该研究提供了一种基于星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡的血液检测策略，直接捕获中枢神经系统来源的病理蛋白，有望解决ALS诊断延迟和临床试验患者分层难题。其与TDP-43靶向治疗试验的潜在衔接价值，使其成为ALS生物标志物领域值得跟踪的转化方向。

aiRead.studyType: 多队列诊断准确性研究（生物标志物验证）
aiRead.keyFinding: 血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值在区分ALS与健康对照中表现最佳，逻辑回归模型平均AUC为0.89，平均敏感性87%、特异性89%。
aiRead.limitation: 未充分评估对疾病模拟者的特异性，且与疾病进展的关联尚未明确，样本量有限，需进一步外部验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注该标志物在疾病模拟者中的特异性验证、与疾病进展及治疗反应的纵向关联，以及在TDP-43靶向临床试验中的分层应用。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前亟需非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表了一种有前景的中枢神经系统液体活检生物标志物。本研究评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）——在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。ADEVs从三个ALS生物样本库/队列的全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离。ADEV质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白水平以与四跨膜蛋白分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。诊断准确性通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证进行评估，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应平均敏感性和特异性分别为87%和89%，随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性及其与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步研究，这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及在TDP-43靶向临床试验中用于患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近报道了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡中磷酸化TDP-43作为ALS血液生物标志物的诊断性能，具有直接支持TDP-43靶向临床试验患者分层的转化价值。

items.title: Anti-LAG-3 antibody treatment initiated after symptom onset extends survival in ALS model mice.
items.summary: Immune checkpoint molecules have emerged as regulators of microglial function in neurodegenerative diseases. We previously demonstrated that LAG-3 shapes disease-associated microglial phenotypes in ALS and that germline LAG-3 deletion in SOD1 G93A mice accelerated disease onset but extended duration, leaving survival unchanged. Here, we investigated the therapeutic efficacy of anti-LAG-3 antibody treatment starting after symptom onset. Anti-LAG-3 treatment extended survival, slowed neurological and motor decline, preserved body weight and motor neurons, and reduced microgliosis. Within microglia, the Axl + phagocytic-module fraction increased while the Dectin-1 + inflammatory-module fraction decreased. These findings indicate that post-onset LAG-3 inhibition is a promising therapeutic strategy for ALS.
items.titleZh: 症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗可延长ALS模型小鼠的生存期
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1 G93A ALS模型小鼠中，于症状出现后给予抗LAG-3抗体治疗。结果显示治疗可延长生存期、减缓神经与运动功能下降、保护体重和运动神经元、减轻小胶质细胞增生，并促使小胶质细胞从炎症表型向吞噬表型转变。研究提示症状出现后抑制LAG-3可能具有治疗潜力，但尚属动物实验阶段。
items.insight: 该研究首次在ALS模型小鼠中证明，症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗仍可延长生存期并改善多项病理指标，且伴随小胶质细胞表型由炎症模块向吞噬模块转变。这为免疫检查点抑制作为ALS治疗策略提供了临床前概念验证，并提示LAG-3可能是可干预的神经炎症靶点。后续需关注该策略在其它ALS模型中的可重复性、与现有疗法的联合效果以及向临床转化的安全性。

aiRead.studyType: 动物实验（SOD1 G93A ALS模型小鼠，症状出现后给予抗LAG-3抗体治疗）
aiRead.keyFinding: 症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗可延长ALS模型小鼠生存期、减缓神经与运动功能衰退、保护运动神经元，并促使小胶质细胞从炎症表型向吞噬表型转变。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1 G93A小鼠模型，尚不能确定该疗法在人类ALS中的有效性、安全性及适用人群；且此前生殖系LAG-3缺失未改变生存期，提示治疗时机和方式可能影响结果。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该策略在其它ALS模型中的验证、与现有疗法的联合研究，以及抗LAG-3抗体在ALS患者中的早期临床试验进展。

items.abstractZh: 免疫检查点分子已成为神经退行性疾病中小胶质细胞功能的调节因子。我们此前证明，LAG-3塑造了ALS中疾病相关的小胶质细胞表型，并且SOD1 G93A小鼠的生殖系LAG-3缺失加速了疾病发作，但延长了持续时间，生存期未变。在此，我们研究了症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗的治疗效果。抗LAG-3治疗延长了生存期，减缓了神经和运动功能衰退，保持了体重和运动神经元，并减少了小胶质细胞增生。在小胶质细胞内，Axl+吞噬模块比例增加，而Dectin-1+炎症模块比例减少。这些发现表明，症状出现后抑制LAG-3是ALS的一种有前景的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近证明症状出现后抑制免疫检查点LAG-3可延长ALS模型小鼠生存期并调节小胶质细胞表型，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: Non-invasive brain stimulation in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of transcranial direct current stimulation and transcranial magnetic stimulation.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with limited disease-modifying treatments. Noninvasive brain stimulation techniques have been investigated as potential neuromodulatory interventions targeting cortical hyperexcitability in ALS. To systematically evaluate the clinical efficacy, neurophysiological effects, and safety of tDCS and TMS-based interventions in ALS. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted following PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library were searched from inception to March 2026. Thirty studies involving ALS patients were included. Pooled analyses showed no significant difference between active stimulation and sham in ALSFRS-R at 6 months (MD = 0.58, 95% CI - 0.16 to 1.31) or at end of follow-up (MD = 0.20, 95% CI - 0.49 to 0.89). No significant effect was observed for manual muscle testing. Considerable heterogeneity was noted across studies. However, several studies demonstrated modulation of cortical excitability and intracortical inhibitory circuits, particularly with repeated stimulation protocols. Both tDCS and TMS were consistently safe and well tolerated, with no serious adverse events reported. Noninvasive brain stimulation in ALS does not significantly improve functional outcomes, but induces measurable neurophysiological changes with a strong safety profile. Further studies should optimize protocols and identify responsive subgroups. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive disease that damages the nerve cells responsible for controlling muscles. As the disease advances, people gradually lose the ability to move, speak, swallow, and breathe. Current treatments provide only limited benefits, so researchers continue to explore new approaches that may help slow disease progression or improve quality of life. This study reviewed and analyzed published research on two noninvasive brain stimulation techniques: transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). These techniques use electrical or magnetic stimulation applied through the scalp to influence brain activity. Researchers have proposed that they may help reduce abnormal brain activity that is thought to contribute to ALS. We identified 30 studies that evaluated these techniques in people with ALS. When the results of comparable studies were combined, neither tDCS nor TMS showed a significant improvement in overall functional ability or muscle strength compared with sham (placebo) stimulation. However, several studies reported changes in measures of brain activity, suggesting that these techniques can influence the nervous system in meaningful ways. Importantly, both tDCS and TMS were generally safe and well tolerated, with only mild and temporary side effects such as tingling, itching, or discomfort. Overall, current evidence suggests that noninvasive brain stimulation is safe but does not yet provide clear evidence of improving disease progression or physical function in ALS. Future research should focus on optimizing stimulation methods, identifying which patients may benefit most, and determining whether these techniques could be used alongside other treatments.
items.evidenceLevel: 系统综述与荟萃分析（纳入研究以随机对照试验为主）
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的无创脑刺激：经颅直流电刺激与经颅磁刺激的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述与荟萃分析纳入30项ALS研究，评估tDCS和TMS的疗效、神经生理效应与安全性。汇总结果显示，与假刺激相比，活性刺激在6个月及随访结束时均未显著改善ALSFRS-R评分，手动肌肉测试也无显著获益，且研究间异质性较大。不过，部分研究观察到皮质兴奋性和皮质内抑制回路被调控，尤其在重复刺激方案中。两种技术总体安全、耐受良好，未报告严重不良事件。作者认为，当前证据不支持无创脑刺激改善ALS功能结局，但支持其神经生理调控作用和良好安全性，未来需优化方案并识别应答亚组。
items.insight: 该荟萃分析为ALS无创脑刺激领域提供了迄今较全面的疗效与安全性汇总证据，明确区分了“功能结局未改善”与“神经生理指标可调控”两个层面。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示未来试验不应仅以ALSFRS-R作为唯一终点，而应结合皮质兴奋性、抑制回路等生物标志物，并针对可能应答的亚组（如皮质高兴奋性明显者）设计富集策略。同时，tDCS/TMS的安全性数据支持其作为联合治疗或机制验证工具的进一步探索。

aiRead.keyFinding: tDCS和TMS在ALS中未显著改善ALSFRS-R或肌力，但可调控皮质兴奋性和皮质内抑制回路，且安全性良好。
aiRead.limitation: 纳入研究间异质性较大，刺激方案、随访时间和结局指标不统一，可能掩盖特定亚组或优化方案下的潜在获益。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展以神经生理标志物为终点、针对皮质高兴奋性亚组的优化方案随机对照试验，以及无创脑刺激与其他ALS治疗联合应用的探索。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，疾病修饰治疗手段有限。无创脑刺激技术已被研究作为针对ALS皮质高兴奋性的潜在神经调控干预措施。旨在系统评价tDCS和基于TMS的干预措施在ALS中的临床疗效、神经生理效应及安全性。按照PRISMA指南进行了系统综述与荟萃分析。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library，检索时间自建库至2026年3月。共纳入30项涉及ALS患者的研究。汇总分析显示，在6个月时（MD = 0.58，95% CI -0.16至1.31）或随访结束时（MD = 0.20，95% CI -0.49至0.89），活性刺激与假刺激在ALSFRS-R方面无显著差异。手动肌肉测试未观察到显著效应。研究间存在相当大的异质性。然而，多项研究显示皮质兴奋性和皮质内抑制回路受到调控，尤其是在重复刺激方案中。tDCS和TMS均一致安全且耐受良好，未报告严重不良事件。ALS中的无创脑刺激未显著改善功能结局，但可诱导可测量的神经生理学变化，且安全性良好。进一步研究应优化方案并识别应答亚组。肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种进行性疾病，会损害控制肌肉的神经细胞。随着疾病进展，患者逐渐丧失移动、说话、吞咽和呼吸的能力。当前治疗仅能提供有限获益，因此研究人员继续探索可能有助于减缓疾病进展或改善生活质量的新方法。本研究回顾并分析了已发表的关于两种无创脑刺激技术的研究：经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。这些技术通过头皮施加电刺激或磁刺激来影响脑活动。研究人员提出，它们可能有助于减少被认为参与ALS发病的异常脑活动。我们识别出30项在ALS患者中评估这些技术的研究。当合并可比研究的结果时，tDCS和TMS均未显示与假（安慰剂）刺激相比在整体功能能力或肌力方面有显著改善。然而，多项研究报告了脑活动指标的变化，提示这些技术能够以有意义的方式影响神经系统。重要的是，tDCS和TMS总体安全且耐受良好，仅出现轻微和暂时的副作用，如刺痛、瘙痒或不适。总体而言，当前证据提示无创脑刺激是安全的，但尚未提供明确证据表明其可改善ALS的疾病进展或躯体功能。未来研究应聚焦于优化刺激方法、识别哪些患者可能获益最大，以及确定这些技术是否可与其他治疗联合使用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，系统整合了ALS无创脑刺激的最新证据，明确其神经生理调控价值与安全性，为优化试验终点和识别应答亚组提供了转化方向。

items.title: Conceptualizing cognition and behaviour across amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia.
items.summary: Cognitive and behavioral dysfunction in frontotemporal dementia (FTD) evolves along a clinical continuum from a clinically silent stage of disease, through a prodromal period, often referred to as mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and/or mild behavioral impairment (MBI), and into a clinically manifest stage recognized by the syndromes of behavioral variant FTD and primary progressive aphasia (PPA). Similar cognitive and behavioral manifestations of varying severity are also encountered in individuals with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Notwithstanding this phenotypic overlap as well as a degree of shared genetic risk and underlying pathology, the approach to phenotypic characterization and description meaningfully differs between the ALS and FTD communities. The problem is particularly evident within the ALS community when describing impairment in the prodromal vs. clinically manifest disease stages. Pertinent considerations include the nature of cognitive and behavioral assessments, the nosology used to describe symptoms identified including those encompassed by the terms 'behavioral' and 'neuropsychiatric', the operationalized criteria that define prodromal syndromes and clinically manifest disease, and the extent to which these criteria rely on longitudinal (vs. cross-sectional) data. A multi-stakeholder workshop, held in London, Ontario (May 12-14, 2025), brought together neurologists, psychiatrists, neuropsychologists, neuropathologists, neuroscientists, and neurogeneticists studying ALS and FTD, to promote inter-disciplinary dialogue and to define a research agenda that might be jointly tackled to address these critical issues. A new nosology for classifying frontotemporal-related behavioral and neuropsychiatric dysfunction, which could be used to support empirical evidence collection, is proposed alongside a list of cognitive, language, behavioral and neuropsychiatric symptoms to be considered in the evaluation of individuals with ALS. Research priorities for each of the ALS and FTD communities, as well as initiatives that should be undertaken jointly, are highlighted. The long-term goal is to harmonize approaches to phenotypic characterization, the nosology used to describe symptoms, and the criteria used to define landmark stages along the clinical continua of the motor neuron and frontotemporal axes irrespective of clinical stage.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化与额颞叶痴呆中认知和行为的统一概念化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇来自2025年伦敦（安大略省）多学科研讨会的共识性论文，旨在统一ALS和FTD中认知与行为障碍的表型描述、疾病分类和诊断标准。文章指出，尽管ALS和FTD在认知行为表型、遗传风险和病理上存在重叠，但两个领域在描述前驱期与显现阶段损害时方法差异显著。研讨会提出了新的额颞叶相关行为和神经精神功能障碍分类学，以及ALS评估中应关注的症状清单，并明确了各自及联合研究优先事项。

items.abstractZh: 额颞叶痴呆（FTD）中的认知和行为功能障碍沿着一个临床连续谱演变：从临床静默期，经过前驱期（常被称为轻度认知障碍和/或轻度行为损害），进入以行为变异型FTD和原发性进行性失语（PPA）综合征为标志的临床显现阶段。在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者中也会遇到严重程度各异的类似认知和行为表现。尽管存在这种表型重叠以及一定程度的共享遗传风险和潜在病理，ALS和FTD学界在表型特征描述和界定方法上存在显著差异。这一问题在ALS学界描述前驱期与临床显现阶段损害时尤为突出。相关考量包括：认知和行为评估的性质、用于描述所识别症状（包括'行为'和'神经精神'术语所涵盖的症状）的疾病分类学、定义前驱综合征和临床显性疾病的标准化诊断标准，以及这些标准在多大程度上依赖纵向（而非横断面）数据。2025年5月12日至14日在加拿大安大略省伦敦市举行的一次多方利益相关者研讨会，汇集了研究ALS和FTD的神经病学家、精神病学家、神经心理学家、神经病理学家、神经科学家和神经遗传学家，以促进跨学科对话并确定可共同应对这些关键问题的研究议程。本文提出了一种用于分类额颞叶相关行为和神经精神功能障碍的新疾病分类学，可用于支持实证证据的收集，同时提出了一份在ALS患者评估中应考虑的认知、语言、行为和神经精神症状清单。文中强调了ALS和FTD各自学界的研究优先事项，以及应联合开展的倡议。长期目标是统一表型特征描述方法、用于描述症状的疾病分类学，以及用于定义运动神经元轴和额颞叶轴临床连续谱上各标志性阶段的标准，而不论临床阶段如何。
items.frontierRationale: 该文基于2025年最新多学科研讨会，针对ALS与FTD认知行为表型分类不统一这一阻碍领域进展的核心问题提出新分类框架，具有直接的转化研究协调价值。

items.title: Dysregulated microRNA-mRNA networks in SOD1G93A mouse skeletal muscle reveal metabolic impairments in ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a multi-system disease in which skeletal muscle actively contributes to pathology, yet the regulatory circuits that drive muscle dysfunction remain unclear. We examined microRNA (miRNA)-messenger RNA (mRNA) interactions in the gastrocnemius of hSOD1G93A mice across presymptomatic, early- and late-symptomatic stages, using RNA-seq, bioinformatics, and RT-qPCR. Compared with hSOD1WT and non-transgenic controls, hSOD1G93A muscle showed mutation-specific transcriptome reprogramming: 48 dysregulated miRNAs and 558 mRNAs at presymptomatic, and 64 miRNAs and 685 mRNAs at late-symptomatic stages. Functional enrichment pinpointed carbohydrate-handling pathways (glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, pentose-phosphate, fructose-mannose metabolism) as the dominant downregulated gene sets. Network analysis revealed clusters in which upregulated miRNAs converged on, and showed inverse expression patterns relative to metabolic transcripts. RT-qPCR confirmed inverse expression of 10 candidate miRNAs and 11 metabolic mRNAs, substantiating miRNA-guided repression of glycolytic enzymes and energy-sensing nodes. Collectively, we show that SOD1G93A drives an early, sustained miRNA signature that dampens glycolysis gene expression, which could promote the fast-to-slow fibre-type transition and exacerbate energy deficit in ALS muscle. Targeting these circuits offers a strategy to restore metabolic balance and slow disease progression.
items.titleZh: SOD1G93A小鼠骨骼肌中失调的microRNA-mRNA网络揭示ALS代谢损伤
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1G93A ALS小鼠模型中，分析了骨骼肌在不同疾病阶段的miRNA-mRNA调控网络。发现突变特异性转录组重编程，以碳水化合物代谢通路（尤其是糖酵解）下调为突出特征，且上调的miRNA与代谢基因表达呈负相关。研究提示miRNA介导的糖酵解抑制可能促进肌纤维类型转变并加剧能量缺陷，靶向这些回路或可恢复代谢平衡。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种多系统疾病，其中骨骼肌主动参与病理过程，但驱动肌肉功能障碍的调控回路仍不清楚。我们使用RNA-seq、生物信息学和RT-qPCR，检测了hSOD1G93A小鼠腓肠肌在症状前、早期症状和晚期症状阶段的microRNA（miRNA）-信使RNA（mRNA）相互作用。与hSOD1WT和非转基因对照相比，hSOD1G93A肌肉显示出突变特异性转录组重编程：症状前阶段有48个失调miRNA和558个mRNA，晚期症状阶段有64个miRNA和685个mRNA。功能富集指出碳水化合物处理通路（糖酵解/糖异生、磷酸戊糖途径、果糖-甘露糖代谢）是主要下调的基因集。网络分析揭示了上调miRNA汇聚于代谢转录本并与其呈现反向表达模式的簇。RT-qPCR证实了10个候选miRNA和11个代谢mRNA的反向表达，证实了miRNA引导的糖酵解酶和能量感应节点的抑制。总之，我们表明SOD1G93A驱动一个早期、持续的miRNA特征，抑制糖酵解基因表达，这可能促进快肌向慢肌纤维类型转变并加剧ALS肌肉中的能量缺陷。靶向这些回路提供了恢复代谢平衡和减缓疾病进展的策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了SOD1G93A小鼠骨骼肌中早期持续的miRNA网络通过抑制糖酵解基因表达驱动代谢损伤，为ALS肌肉代谢靶向干预提供了转化线索。
